scoped_data_access.semantics: 目标行/字段下推到真实数据读取；空行不扩大范围，空字段只读身份版本；权限/规则依赖不对外泄露；日常失败不退回整表或旧存储
scoped_data_access.catalog: objects支持page/page_length/summary/search/attribution_level；授权筛选先于total和分页，只装配本页元数据
scoped_data_access.resource_resolution: resolve_table_resource(resource_id)按完整身份定位；拒权、停用、歧义不猜测其他来源
scoped_data_access.read_services: read_registered_service仅执行注册effect=read；service_read支持GET与带CSRF的POST，经同一权限/schema/lifecycle；BFF按编码后URL长度预选传输且支持客户端取消，错误不换口重试
scoped_data_access.writes: 沿公共Action提交目标patch；规则、版本、事务、完整逐条审计及原生钩子不减；Frappe可能更新完整目标行，不承诺物理SQL只更新一列
scoped_data_access.compatibility: 原分页查询默认字段与定义回包保持；工程全量受管读须显式声明用途，所有受支持内置消费者本批迁移；不得增加运行失败回退

partial_action_review.optional_action_declaration: review_handler (private, trusted original-domain callback; omitted actions retain whole-action confirmation)

unit_status_meaning.staged: marked as reviewed-and-kept (staged); **no formal value written**
unit_status_meaning.accepted: adopted; the formal value was written at that moment
unit_status_meaning.rejected: discarded; no formal value was ever written

unit_optional.staged_value: the candidate value kept when staging (the value the person edited at staging time; equals unit.value when not edited)
unit_optional.adopted_value: the value actually adopted at acceptance time

descriptor.source: created_via from original authorized proposal, never candidate payload.source
descriptor.read_side_effect: no formal values, drafts, or sheet metadata writes

accept_request.edited_value: map of selected descriptor unit_id to raw candidate value; cannot change unit identity, target, versions, or operation key

stage.what: the **staged** tier of a descriptor unit: marked as reviewed-and-kept; **no formal value is written**

request.units_omitted: all still-pending units; already staged units are not staged twice, adopted or discarded units are never included
request.edited_value: same shape as accept_request.edited_value; the staged candidate is the value the person edited at staging time
request.unstage_units_required: unstage requires an explicit unit list; there is no unstaging-everything call

receipt.shape: the same shape as the /review descriptor (_public): units[].status / review_revision / remaining / counts
receipt.staged_units: the unit_ids staged by this call
receipt.unstaged_units: the unit_ids unstaged by this call
receipt.idempotent: true when this call replays the same op_id (no second effect)

semantics.staged_is_not_adopted: staged ≠ adopted ≠ saved: staging only marks the unit; the **formal value is not written at all**
semantics.staged_is_not_saved: only adoption (/accept) writes the formal value, and only an explicit save (submitting the whole set) puts it into the database
semantics.no_formal_write: stage/unstage never write a formal value and never invoke the original registered action
semantics.group_rule_not_bypassed: staging does not bypass whole-set saving: the whole-group check (check_review_group) still runs at /accept time and a group that forbids partial saving still rejects a partial submission; a staged unit does not count as 'already reviewed' because nothing was submitted yet

partial_action_review.concurrency: lock proposal, current domain resource guard/lock, preflight whole selected set, one original registered action, state and formal facts in same transaction
partial_action_review.versions: first acceptance checks original action resource versions; later selection checks captured pending baselines plus opaque current review revision
partial_action_review.idempotency: same op_id and canonical selection/edit fingerprint recovers first registered-action result after current permission/replay guards; changed selection/value under same key rejects; descriptor reflects current review state
partial_action_review.completion: partial remains Proposed; no remaining becomes Confirmed; already accepted values subsequently changed by humans are preserved by remaining acceptance
partial_action_review.reject: discard remaining only; preserve previously accepted formal facts; no invented current values when old position vanished (current_values_unavailable=true, terminal units=[]); existing never-accepted terminal resolve retry may keep legacy status/idempotent projection
partial_action_review.legacy_confirmation: supported pending/partial resolve confirmed applies remaining only; unsupported actions and historical whole-action receipts retain existing flow

mail.body: one whole unit, bundles body_format, inline_resources and reply context; attachments bundle labels
mail.new_draft: authorized descriptor is zero creation; first acceptance creates and binds same mail thereafter
mail.new_shared_mailbox: explicit pending mailbox must be selected together with nonempty content, never silently accepted; empty draft remains rejected by original action
mail.send_gate: assert_no_pending_proposal_reviews(real target) inside original authorized send action, before transport credentials; no external send from acceptance

excel.unit: stable row_id plus actual current header; domain-issued opaque unit_id, original typed cell values
excel.write: original authorized sheet action, no alternate storage writer or promotion implementation

partial_action_review.migration: optional Shangshu Action Proposal.review_state_json, DocType reload before code activation; ensure_registered_domains refresh of private hooks; no old value conversion
partial_action_review.privacy: current original/bound resource authority on descriptor/list/accept/reject/replay; private callback paths and operation receipts are not in public domain contribution projection

proposal_unit_review.state: same original proposal; actor-bound; optional owner-App review_handler
proposal_unit_review.writes: original registered Action, confirmation, permissions, domain barrier and audit
proposal_unit_review.concurrency: preview revision and unchanged pending-unit baselines; no automatic target substitution
proposal_unit_review.idempotency: same op_id requires same selected units and edits; reauthorize before receipt replay
proposal_unit_review.compatibility: legacy whole confirmation unchanged; after partial adoption confirms only remaining units

office_integration.existing_unattributed_resources: original permissions retained; no automatic assignment
office_integration.proposal_edited_value: optional typed single-value edit; original and adopted values audited
office_integration.replay_guard: optional owner callback(payload,request), legacy single-argument callbacks supported
office_integration.transaction_failure: executor savepoint only; failure receipt persisted only at outer HTTP boundary
office_integration.domain_action_audits: owner-domain context only; self for employees, all for System Manager

reference_work.source: registered native object and exact record
reference_work.execution_actor_field: explicit object declaration; current owner always rechecked
reference_work.execution_guard: optional original App readonly permission callback
reference_work.work_update_guard: optional original App callback(doc,user,action_pin); source read and original audited write Action mandatory
reference_work.proposals: optional execution_id binds original confirmation; revoke rejects unexecuted proposals
reference_work.notifications: single recipient/source fact; original-domain audited write Action only; no external mail
reference_work.compatibility: old unscoped chat and proposals unchanged; new integrations require API >=1.8/core >=0.4

managed_record_import.mapping: 逻辑字段 ID → 从 1 开始的源列号；不按重复表头猜映射
managed_record_import.semantics: 既有普通标量表；显式唯一匹配、重复/回收冲突拒绝；重算预览指纹，整批数据库事务复用原 create/update 与逐行审计；不建表、不存源文件、不执行公式
managed_record_import.compatibility: 本地增量尚未部署，先同步贡献/Action；新建表导入与前端入口另行验收

managed_record_history.storage: Shangshu Action Execution Audit.record_changes_json（同事务、不可变、幂等唯一）
managed_record_history.permission: 当前对象/记录/字段及关联目标权限重新投影；不暴露不可读字段名或值
managed_record_history.semantics: 接入后的真实字段前后值、操作者与时间；不推算旧历史；关联名称按当前可见标签展示
managed_record_history.compatibility: 先迁移可选审计字段并同步贡献，再启用；旧内核未声明 history 时不展示入口

managed_record_export.permission: 复用受管对象权限查询；首批仅管理员，不自动开放员工导出
managed_record_export.semantics: 全部符合筛选的正式记录与授权列；无内部元数据；不包含未保存值；不支持明细列；超限拒绝不截断
managed_record_export.compatibility: 对象 export 能力明确声明 available 后才启用页面入口

meaning.name: 行 ID（技术标识，不是业务身份）
meaning.modified: **最后写入**的时间（防覆盖的比对源；审一次就变一次）
meaning.creation: **这条记录进到这个受管对象的时间**（PKG-068-T01：用户 2026-10-23 22:1x 拍板「给审核中心配一个进入的时间，这一个字段**以后所有的业务域只要往审核中心塞东西都记录**」⇒ 这一列落在**内核** ⇒ **所有域**的受管记录都自带进入时间）

row_tail.rule: 这三列是**内核给的固定尾注** ⇒ 域**不许**拿它们当自己的受管字段名（域声明同名字段 ⇒ 注册当场被拒）

managed_record_query.permission: 当前可读字段与记录范围先于搜索、排序、计数和分页；关键词字面包含
managed_record_query.compatibility: 逻辑字段精确筛选与原查询入口不变；无 query 能力声明时客户端不得发送新键

http_process_start.migration: 原始 HTTP 发起口因绕过授权与确认停止写入；Python start_process 不变，现有受管 process_launch 不变

stability.same_major: 只能增加向后兼容的可选字段或操作
stability.breaking: 删除、重命名、权限或运行语义破坏必须升级 major
stability.deprecation: 至少保留一个已发布 minor 周期

mutable_file_storage.semantics: one stable private current File; no per-edit historical File/Version creation; content revision independent of archive count
mutable_file_storage.transaction: resource and File DB locks before OS file lock; fsynced atomic replacement; rollback before-image removed after DB commit; crash recovery selected by committed hash
mutable_file_storage.attachment_binding: mutable content is frozen into an immutable attachment only when explicitly attached; mutable hash namespace excluded from immutable blob deduplication

proposal_definition_snapshot.private_hook: optional Action.proposal_snapshot(action_id,payload,purpose,snapshot), purpose capture/inspect/validate; removed from public contributions
proposal_definition_snapshot.storage: server-only Shangshu Action Proposal.definition_snapshot_json; action payload and idempotency binding unchanged
proposal_definition_snapshot.enforcement: capture only when creating new proposal; validate under target lock before fresh whole/per-unit acceptance; inspect only affects can_accept; never replace creation snapshot on retry
proposal_definition_snapshot.compatibility: opted-in old proposals with no snapshot remain readable/rejectable but cannot be accepted; successful receipt replay keeps original current permission guard and never executes a new write
proposal_definition_snapshot.migration: reload Shangshu Action Proposal before activating code; refresh registered domain contributions; no automatic backfill from current definitions

candidate_field_projection.private_hook: optional Action.proposal_projection(action_id,payload) returns payload, redacted and optional visible unit_ids
candidate_field_projection.reads: current field read applies before payload, summary, original, edited values, bytes, units, pagination counts and proposal visibility; raw receipts withheld on projected partial review
candidate_field_projection.review: per-unit review only accepts currently readable units; all_unit_ids stays internal so hidden pending units are never marked confirmed by visible acceptance; remaining/counts only refer to visible units
candidate_field_projection.indivisible_actions: non-unit actions with redacted fields cannot be fully accepted; coordinate matrix containing hidden field is denied rather than shifted/reinterpreted
candidate_field_projection.migration: refresh registered private domain callbacks; no stored candidate rewrite

action_execution_guard.phase: after authorization and idempotency reservation, before action handler; same outer transaction

organization_audit_read.approval: 2026-10-19 user: owner enterprise logs, department head managed department and descendants logs; ordinary own behavior unchanged
organization_audit_read.scope: independent audit purpose, current enterprise and active viewer identity; current org appointments, never resource shares/manager label
organization_audit_read.actors: authorize_audit_actor(user) and GET public_api.http.audit_actor?user= returns one authorized immutable identity/collaboration mapping; caller must use this mapping before reading actual conversation evidence
organization_audit_read.source: source comes from authenticated execution context/audit executor_source; absent historical source is unknown, never invented user/ai
organization_audit_read.legacy: existing System Manager operations access retained within authenticated enterprise; no ordinary employee global audit page
organization_audit_read.query: query_action_audits(filters,page,page_length), GET public_api.http.action_audits; exact filters actor_user/action_id/status/executor_source/name/idempotency_key; total and pagination share authorized filters; persisted summaries remain summaries, conversation_evidence not_linked unless trusted mapping exists
organization_audit_read.proposal: get_audit_proposal(user,proposal_id), GET http.audit_proposal; first authorize actor then require same proposal actor and enterprise; decision/receipt metadata only, no candidate/payload/summary; audit_only never grants confirmation; accepted/receipts bounded 200 with counts/truncation

atomic_action_packages.declaration: registered action resource transaction=atomic_package, exact transaction_versions and package_actions allowlist; optional owner package_guard selects managed companions
atomic_action_packages.boundary: only declared root handler; ordinary orchestration is not grouped; each child retains role/schema/confirmation/version/rules/request binding; DDL and migration prohibited
atomic_action_packages.audit: one registered action one successful unified log; root detail.package={version,steps,record_count,change_count}; complete actual record_changes in each step, summaries once per step; child execution details have no separate successful log
atomic_action_packages.receipt: root and committed child request audit point to root log; exact root replay produces no new effects/log; standalone successful child request cannot be spliced into a new package
atomic_action_packages.failure: child exceptions poison root even if caught; executor savepoint rollback plus registered resource checkpoint compensation; root Failed Action Request persisted only at existing HTTP boundary, no success log remains
atomic_action_packages.resource_compensation: trusted Python register_package_rollback(callback,key=None), returns True only for new registration, False outside a package or for duplicate keys; reverse rollback on failure; incomplete compensation blocks commit
atomic_action_packages.history: old successful action requests replay after existing permission guards; old package versions reject new execution or Failed retry; ordinary actions and native companion guard=False retain original behavior; Sheet Op undo snapshots remain authoritative
atomic_action_packages.counts: record_count counts unique (doctype,name) targets; change_count and step_change_count count all actual field changes across steps

transaction_failure_guard.scope: current database instance and whole outer transaction; no lock changes
transaction_failure_guard.detection: Frappe QueryDeadlockError/QueryTimeoutError; PyMySQL Error codes 1213/1205/1020/2006/2013; InterfaceError; kernel rollback error 1305; cause/context traversed without text matching
transaction_failure_guard.failure: rethrow original failure, block commit before Frappe clears rollback callbacks; no pending/success log/receipt; no automatic retry or reconnect
transaction_failure_guard.reset: only a full rollback and all recovery callbacks succeeding; savepoint rollback does not reset; failed full recovery requires explicit recovery or disposal of the connection
transaction_failure_guard.ordinary_error: unchanged pending and package savepoint behavior
transaction_failure_guard.http_receipt: existing failure receipt path after full rollback; receipt errors never replace the original action error

conversation_evidence.credential: Server-issued, actor and enterprise bound, 24 hour TTL; no caller-supplied key or text used as evidence
conversation_evidence.persistence: Proposal pins the key; confirmation cannot override it. Log association is written with the existing action transaction. Legacy rows remain not_linked.
conversation_evidence.action_window: Same conversation_key and authorized actor scope before LIMIT. Anchor log_no, creation/name total order, default 4 rows per side, maximum 20.
conversation_evidence.user_message_window: Explicit GET /api/platform/audit-chat reads the stored request/proposal turn, up to 4 user messages each side and their internal calls. Original chat storage is authoritative.
conversation_evidence.performance: One credential per bridge run; no new conversation table. Confirmation reuses the loaded proposal. Normal provenance reads do not load the message window. Chat indexes cover chat entities only.
